description: This is a PHP source file defining the ModuleDao class, which manages module entries in the 'ohrm_module' database table within the OrangeHRM HRM system. It includes methods for retrieving module lists, updating module statuses, and managing permissions related to data groups and widget modules.

classes.name: ModuleDao
classes.description: This class manages module entries in the database, providing methods for listing, updating status, and managing permissions related to modules in the OrangeHRM system.

methods.name: getModuleList
methods.description: Retrieves a list of all module entities from the database.

methods.name: updateModuleStatus
methods.description: Updates the status (enabled/disabled) of modules based on the provided associative array mapping module names to boolean statuses.

methods.name: getDisabledModuleList
methods.description: Returns a list of module names that are currently disabled.

methods.name: getEnabledModuleNameList
methods.description: Returns a list of module names that are currently enabled.

methods.name: updateDataGroupPermissionForWidgetModules
methods.description: Updates read permissions for widget modules associated with a specific data group.
